integrity: Proof is analytic by a fully specified unique Lyapunov solution. The attached standalone program checks finite matrices using exact arithmetic and an independent numerical solver; finite checks alone are not an infinite-length proof. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: A finite homogeneous nearest-neighbor open path with one terminal Lindblad jump and one excitation. Not a projectively measured walk, and no statement about general nonuniform, disordered, many-body, dephasing, multi-sink or infinite-chain systems. General first-jump superoperator moment inversion was known; historical path-specific coverage cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Exact absorption-time operator and size-independent sink optimum on quantum paths
